camera_label: Creative Live! Cam Sync 1080p V2 - physical unit A
method: OpenCV calibrateCamera, five distortion coefficients; diagnostics with calibrateCameraExtended

leave_one_out.method: Refit intrinsics on 19 views, solvePnP for the held-out board pose, then evaluate held-out corner reprojection RMS; repeat for every image

assessment: Suitable as the initial intrinsic calibration for subsequent external calibration and geometric validation; no mandatory image retake identified by these checks.
limitations: These are 2D board reprojection errors, not physical 3D position or height accuracy.
Leave-one-out uses the same capture session and estimates each held-out board pose; it is not independent physical ground-truth validation.
The source JSON contains an identity world_to_camera placeholder. Camera placement and table-frame extrinsics are NOT calibrated; do not use it as a completed live rig calibration.
The calibration belongs only to camera A and the same 1280x720 lens/focus/zoom/crop configuration.
Corner counts were redetected from saved JPEGs and may differ from uncompressed live-frame counts at capture.
Keep the original images and perform independent table-plane and known-height checks after extrinsic calibration.
